symptom: An anonymous request to /admin returned HTTP 200 and the rendered HTML contained administration navigation before authentication.
expected_behavior: Every /admin route redirects to Google authentication before any administration shell or management content is rendered.
environment: VII release candidate based on source commit 81f1f11f5d6e8bc8a9586806af3fc63fbbb43ee3; temporary production host https://vii.spaplus.co on 2026-10-15.

steps: Request https://vii.spaplus.co/admin without cookies and without following redirects.
Inspect the HTTP status, Location header and response HTML.
reproduction.evidence: The deployed pre-fix response returned HTTP 200, no Location header, and HTML matching administration shell labels.

observations.observation: Administrative API routes already deny anonymous and non-allowlisted accounts.
observations.evidence: Existing admin authorization tests pass for overview, catalog, redirects and search-page APIs.

observations.observation: The administration layout rendered AdminNav and AdminCommandBar without a server-side session gate.
observations.evidence: Pre-fix app/admin/layout.tsx contained the shell directly and delegated authorization to client page fetches.

hypotheses.mechanism: Authorization existed only in administrative APIs, so the shared administration layout rendered before client requests could receive 403.
hypotheses.prediction: Anonymous HTML contains administration shell text even though subsequent API requests are denied.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare the anonymous /admin HTML response with anonymous API authorization tests.
hypotheses.result: The public host returned the shell with HTTP 200 while the API denial tests passed.

hypotheses.mechanism: The Google OAuth callback or administrator allowlist incorrectly authorized anonymous visitors.
hypotheses.prediction: Anonymous administrative API calls would also succeed or an anonymous session would be returned.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run anonymous and signed non-admin tests against the shared session and administrative APIs.
hypotheses.result: Anonymous and signed non-admin requests were denied; the allowlist was not the exposure mechanism.

fix.change: Add one server-side authorization helper and require it in app/admin/layout.tsx before rendering any administration shell. Redirect anonymous accounts to Google authentication and signed non-admin accounts to the account page.
fix.evidence: Three admin-session unit tests pass, and built-worker assertions show /admin, /admin/search-pages, /admin/catalog-sync and /admin/redirects redirect without shell content.

affected_family: Every route rendered under the shared /admin server layout

regression_checks.evidence: tests/admin-server-gate.test.mjs denies a signed-in address outside the administrator allowlist.
tests/admin-server-gate.test.mjs accepts an allowed administrator case-insensitively.
tests/launch-seo.test.mjs verifies four representative built routes redirect before rendering shell text.

remaining_unknowns: The exact public deployment must be rechecked after publishing the candidate.
authorization_boundary: Diagnosis and candidate repair are authorized; changing the old-domain DNS or origin remains outside this repair.
